items.meta_title: Cloak Mode: Undetectable VPN Traffic | VpnHood!
items.meta_description: Cloak Mode disguises VPN traffic as ordinary web traffic, so deep packet inspection has no signature to match. Available in VpnHood!
items.title: Cloak Mode
items.lead: Overcomes VPN blocks by disguising your VPN traffic as regular web traffic, making it resistant to deep packet inspection.
items.shot_alt: The Cloak Mode screen in the VpnHood! app
items.how_desc: Most VPN protocols announce themselves. Deep packet inspection reads the shape of the traffic, recognizes the protocol on sight, and a network that wants to block VPNs simply drops it. Cloak Mode wraps the tunnel so it looks like ordinary encrypted web traffic, leaving nothing familiar for a filter to match against.
items.when_desc: Turn it on when a network is actively fighting VPNs: a school or office firewall, hotel and airport Wi-Fi that blocks tunnels, or a national filter. On a home connection that is not blocking anything, you do not need it.
items.cost_desc: Cloaked traffic carries more overhead than a direct tunnel, so it can be a little slower and use slightly more battery. That is the trade: raw speed when nothing is in your way, a connection that still works when something is.
